ayahs.textEn: Nũn. By the pen and what everyone writes!
By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane.
You will certainly have a never-ending reward.
And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character.
Soon you and the pagans will see,
which of you is mad.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided.
So do not give in to the deniers.
They wish you would compromise so they would yield ˹to you˺.
And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker,
slanderer, gossip-monger,
withholder of good, transgressor, evildoer,
brute, and—on top of all that—an illegitimate child.
Now, ˹simply˺ because he has been blessed with ˹abundant˺ wealth and children,

ayahs.textAr: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”
We will soon mark his snout.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning,
leaving no thought for Allah’s Will.

ayahs.textAr: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept,
so it was reduced to ashes.
Then by daybreak they called out to each other,

ayahs.textAr: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”
So they went off, whispering to one another,

ayahs.textAr: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”
And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose.
But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way!
In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.textEn: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”
Then they turned on each other, throwing blame.
They said, “Woe to us! We have certainly been transgressors.

ayahs.textAr: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”

ayahs.textAr: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: That is the ˹way of Our˺ punishment ˹in this world˺. But the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly far worse, if only they knew.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord.
Should We then treat those who have submitted like the wicked?
What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
Or do you have a scripture, in which you read
that you will have whatever you choose?

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide?
Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ which of them can guarantee all that.

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they have associate-gods ˹supporting this claim˺? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods, if what they say is true.

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so,

ayahs.textAr: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: with eyes downcast, totally covered with disgrace. For they were ˹always˺ called to prostrate ˹in the world˺ when they were fully capable ˹but they chose not to˺.

ayahs.textAr: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: So leave to Me ˹O Prophet˺ those who reject this message. We will gradually draw them to destruction in ways they cannot comprehend.
I ˹only˺ delay their end for a while, but My planning is flawless.

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Or are you asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt?
Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺?

ayahs.textAr: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress.

ayahs.textAr: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy.
Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”
But it is simply a reminder to the whole world.
